data.narrative:
Calogena is a Series A nuclear energy company founded by Julien Dereux that has raised €100M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable set spanning 11 companies—3 public (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private firms including Fuse Energy, Valar Atomics, Oklo, X-Energy, and Nano Nuclear Energy, all operating in the same sector at similar or adjacent funding stages.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the €100M total raised as a proxy baseline and applies a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A advancement, implying a $200M valuation. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables yields a $808M median valuation, with the peer set ranging from $200M (Fuse Energy, Series A) to $6.0B (Valar Atomics, Series B) and a minimum of $200M. These methods produce a triangulated range of $170M (low) to $929M (high), with a median of $504M across the two approaches.

The median valuation of $504M reflects the tension between stage-appropriate step-up multiples and demonstrated peer valuations in an active, heterogeneous market segment. Key uncertainties include technology differentiation relative to peers, capital efficiency post-Series A, and regulatory pathway clarity for advanced reactor designs, all of which drive the wide peer range and merit closer scrutiny in diligence.
